profile.provenance: The studio DNG and raw.pixls.us #1760 store identical model, illuminants and both SRATIONAL matrices. Building from the studio DNG gives the same DCP bytes. Use the existing installed profile once for both optics conditions.

plan.reference: Embedded JPEG from each exact RAW only, not stand-alone publisher JPEG. sRGB interpretation via source metadata; no color scoring in this phase.

selection.rule: Frozen original grid cells, rank candidate centers by JPEG green-gradient template standard deviation, then ascending y/x. Select JPEG-only centers through the exact prior texture_centers function. Fit/holdout inherit cell checkerboard parity. Use these saved sites; do not reselect after exports.

registration.coordinate_rule: Round fractions of width-1 and height-1 in each case's frozen embedded JPEG (the tag is listed in cases); origin upper left; X horizontal; use the same nominal centers in its equal-size TIFF for template search.
registration.gradient: Gaussian sigma 1.4 / Sobel magnitude of encoded green, uint16 divided by 257. No ICC, Lab or residuals used for registration.
registration.peak_distance_rule: Chebyshev distance for the alternate correlation peak exclusion
registration.holdout_rule: even checkerboard parity estimates global affine; odd parity is held out

local_verification.rule: If global affine passes, use only its mapped ROI coordinates; otherwise translate each fixed ROI by its own independently matched central shift. The 4 holdout templates are outside the ROI. Require >=3 accepted holdouts, both x and y sides and all accepted holdout residuals <=0.85 px. Do not refine either transform with holdouts. No extrapolation or full-frame score.

mask.tiff_support: Require all four bilinear source neighbors to pass gradient/endpoint mask; compare before color conversion. Sample TIFF RGB16 bilinearly at fixed coordinates. JPEG sampled on integer grid.

plan.gates: Use original 25 correlation/peak/shift/holdout and mask gates verbatim at the saved sites. The original grid coordinate text describes the cell centers; the saved texture centers replace nominal coordinates. For every condition, require original export dimensions. Do not loosen tolerances, pick a new site, or estimate a nonlinear warp. No geometry success claim until export-side gates are tested.

common_develop.display_temperature_tint: Record actual readout after profile selection; do not copy numeric values from other RAWs.
common_develop.zero_edit_scope: Reset fresh photo or virtual copy to Adobe defaults (no presets, Auto, adaptive profiles, masks, retouching, perspective, crop, or user adjustments). Set selected matrix DCP and only the assigned optics condition. Keep default input detail settings, record all CRS attributes/nested elements, and use no export sharpening.
common_develop.crop: No custom crop/straighten; full reference dimensions. Record HasCrop and normalized bounds; baseline intended uncropped.
common_develop.lens_ui: Record built-in lens-correction message and details per condition. Checkbox names alone do not establish the rendering pipeline.

export.storage: TIFF RGB unsigned 16-bit, chunky, no compression, exact native dimensions, normal orientation

q7-off.scope: Fixed Adobe-off comparator; camera flags are both On.

q7-adobe-optics.lens: Adobe profile explicitly identifying PENTAX 01 Standard Prime / 8.5mm F1.9
q7-adobe-optics.required: Export only if exact lens profile is explicitly selectable and both controls can be observed. Do not substitute a lens, force unavailable controls, or approximate with Manual Distortion. Same reset and input controls as q7-off except optics. Render at most these two conditions.
q7-adobe-optics.ambiguity: Matching names or correction toggles do not prove equal transforms; Adobe and camera algorithms may differ, and built-in processing may affect either condition. Treat both as independent geometry tests.

score_plan.status: Frozen before any Studio29 Lab conversion or scene color scoring
score_plan.mask_and_registration: Replay exact saved sites using the 28 geometry and 25 gather helpers, reproduce the archived fit/holdout diagnostics and all used/excluded region records, and verify each used mask SHA before any scene conversion. No region or pixel added or removed on color evidence. Q7-off must remain geometrically unqualified. ProPhoto export with Adobe optics is scored only for the independent local translations that passed, without asserting equivalence to in-camera optics.
score_plan.interpolation: Use 25's existing cv2.remap INTER_LINEAR on encoded ProPhoto uint16 triplets before ICC transform. JPEG RGB8 stays at integer coordinates. Keep all four contributing source neighbors subject to the frozen endpoint/gradient gate. Interpolating prior to conversion is an inherited, fixed method and does not imply linear-light or Lab interpolation would give equal results.
score_plan.color_conversion: Use exact embedded ProPhoto RGB ICC for the TIFF and LittleCMS built-in sRGB for decoded camera JPEG. K-3 III PEF MakerNote identifies sRGB; Q7 DNG default sRGB is corroborated by its MakerNote. LittleCMS tificc relative colorimetric (-t1), no black-point compensation flag, float32 ICC PCS D50 Lab4 (-o*Lab4 -w32); calculations then float64.
score_plan.metrics: Signed residual means Lightroom minus the paired reference JPEG. C*=hypot(a*,b*) per pixel, delta C* is signed C*_TIFF minus C*_JPEG. Each region reports paired medians of L*/a*/b*/C* residual and median/p90 CIEDE2000 with kL=kC=kH=1. Percentiles use linear interpolation.

aggregation.bin_rules: JPEG Lab only. L uses left-closed/right-open bins except final L includes exactly 100; C uses left-closed/right-open, null=positive infinity. Any out-of-range L is counted as unbinned and remains in the overall statistics.
aggregation.pixel_weighted: Pool all paired masked pixels of a scene or bin; report median signed L*/a*/b*/C*, median and p90 delta E00.
aggregation.equal_region: Calculate the same six statistics separately within each region, then report their unweighted arithmetic means over contributing regions. In bins a region contributes when it has at least one pixel in the bin. Preserve per-bin sample and contributing-region counts. Empty bins have no estimate.

score_plan.interpretation: Two fixed Bright scenes. No fitting, calibrated chart accuracy, ground truth, camera-matched geometry claim, exposure or white-balance alignment, hue angle, or across-camera aggregate. Camera Manual WB and Lightroom As Shot display are distinct. JPEG shadow handling differs between scenes, including K-3 III Auto shadow and Q7 Off, and in-camera tonal/sharpening effects are combined with Lightroom's default input-detail and omitted tone rendering. Published firmware analysis versions differ from the captures. The results apply to the fixed texture-selected, low-gradient/nonendpoint areas.

reference_tests.lab_known_vectors: Synthetic built-in sRGB RGB8 and corresponding RGB16 multiplied by 257. Black/white L* within 0.01, gray a*/b* within 0.02, 16-bit adjacent neutral distinguishes L*, pure red within 0.1 of [54.29,80.81,69.89]. Same Lab has zero delta E00. This is not a scene result.
